notes.title: 2.0.1 Hot fix
notes.content:
Many bugs have been found since the update.

[h3][b]Bug fixes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Unable to enter existing keys (L Shift, R, Space, etc.) in key settings
[*] Always fullscreen when returning to the main menu after gameplay
[*] If a skill that is on cooldown is removed from a hotkey, it is not possible to set the skill to that key
[/list]



[h3][b]Skill Changes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Pistol - High Power : Ammo stockpile changed from 300 reduced to 150 reduced
[/list]



[h3][b]Adjusting Difficulty[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Increase Pistol Ammo Stockpile by 100 on Hard difficulty
[/list]
[b]※ Developer Comment[/b]
We've identified an issue where selecting Pistol-High Powers on Hard difficulty, which decreases your ammo stockpile, can cause your ammo stockpile to drop to 0, unintentionally making the pistol completely unusable.
You can still select the Ammo Stockpile skill, but we didn't intend for it to be required when using High Power rounds, so we've adjusted the numbers.

notes.title: 2.0.0 Achievement Additions Update
notes.content:
[b][u]Because we used a translator, the content may be awkward.[/u][/b]

Hi there,
I'm BigPillar, developer of Polygunner.

It's been two weeks since we released the game.
Despite the fact that the game is still very incomplete, many people are interested in the game,
I want to thank you for playing and post the patch notes.

[h3][b]Adding Steam Achievements[/b][/h3]
The game is now linked to your Steam profile.

[list]
[*] We've added 26 achievements, which we've broken down into three categories: Milestone, Mastery, and Special.
[*] 'Milestone' achievements are for completing the game. They have a green border around the icon.
[*] 'Adept' achievements have harder requirements to achieve.
[*] 'Special' achievements can be earned by successfully performing special maneuvers that were intended by the developers.
[/list]
[b]※ Developer comments[/b]
Since this is the first system we've created, there's a good chance that there will be unintended bugs.
The developers are aware of the potential for bugs and will continue to make sure that the achievement system works as intended.



[h3][b]Key settings[/b][/h3]
You can set some of the keys that were originally fixed to your liking.
[list]
[*] Jump
[*] Run
[*] Switch Rifle
[*] Switch Pistol
[*] Reload
[*] You can set the mouse sensitivity.
However, you cannot set the sensitivity while aiming.
[*] Fixed the key settings window in the main menu UI.
[/list]
[h3][b]※ Note[/b][/h3]
If you've played the game before, be sure to check your key settings.
Your mouse sensitivity and updated keys may be set to 0 and nothing.
Please change the settings manually or reset the settings.



[h3][b]Adjusting the Difficulty System[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Add difficulty calibration to Easy and Hard difficulties.
[/list]
[b]Developer Comments[/b]
In Polygunner, enemies' stats are supposed to increase slightly as the wave rises.
We've added a scaling system to make the stat increases larger or smaller.
This makes it easier on Easy and harder on Hard.



[h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue in the game's initial setup where the graphics quality number was set to more than the maximum.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.1.5 Minor Update
notes.content:
[b]Because we used a translator, the content may be awkward.[/b]

[h2]Game rules[/h2]
[list]
[*] Increased wave start time to 90 seconds
[*] Changed enemies to spawn in two zones
[*] Set to move to the closest available location when the escape button is pressed
[/list]
[h3]Developer comments[/h3]
- The 30-second wave start timer was a concept we created early in development.
However, with the addition of so many abilities and the ability to skip the timer, we realized that we didn't need to set a shorter prep time.
Instead of making the experience of strategically choosing abilities a time-sensitive one, you'll have plenty of time to regroup and prepare for the next battle.

- Reduced the number of times enemies come at you in clusters, and increased the number of areas where enemies spawn so you can experience different situations during combat.

- During game testing, we saw players getting stuck in trees and unable to move at all.
This is a devastatingly negative experience in the game, so we needed to create a solution for this as quickly as possible.
We had the player move to the same location where they started the game, but we changed it to a location that was clearly movable and closest to the player.
This isn't a great solution, though, because it's almost exactly the same location as the enemy's objective.
Getting stuck in terrain and using the escape feature, only to be surrounded by enemies and having your health evaporate in an instant is not a good experience...
The best solution would be to create perfect terrain that doesn't get stuck, but it seems like you're getting stuck in some way.


[h2]Wave 10 Boss[/h2]
[b]Stats[/b]
[list]
[*] Approximately 16% less damage
[/list]
[b]Shot Pattern[/b]
[list]
[*] 33% less projectiles
[*] 20% reduced projectile speed
[*] Approximately 16% narrower firing range (increases accuracy of shots)
[/list]
[b]Blue Orb[/b]
[list]
[*] 12% reduced speed
[*] Reduces projectile durability by 1
[/list]
[b]Orange Orb[/b]
[list]
[*] 1 reduced number of shots
[/list]
[h3]Developer comments[/h3]
- The developers' biggest concern when creating the boss pattern was that the bosses would be too easy.
We thought that defeating an overpowered boss would provide a greater sense of accomplishment, so when we first designed the bosses, we made their attacks stronger and harder to dodge.
After several iterations, we realized that while it's important to get a sense of accomplishment, designing bosses so that their attacks are "guaranteed to hit" isn't necessarily a great experience.
We're always looking at the stats of other bosses as well.

- As an aside, most enemies or projectiles spawned by bosses can be destroyed by attacking them. I should have written that in the game description.


[h2]Wave 20 Boss[/h2]
[b]Common Summon Pattern[/b]
[list]
[*] Spawns 2 fewer mobs
[/list]
[h3]Developer comments[/h3]
- During the second boss's attack, he has the ability to summon common enemies.
 It was not intended that this boss would continue to spawn and stack when not defeated.
 We'll be reducing the amount of common enemies that spawn to reduce this phenomenon as much as possible.


[h2]Wave 30 Boss[/h2]
[b]Stats[/b]
[list]
[*] Approximately 16% reduced movement speed
[/list]

[h2]Player[/h2]
[list]
[*] Pistol base range reduced by 5 meters (approximately 16%)
[*] Rifle base range reduced by 5 meters (approximately 11%)
[/list]
[h3]Developer comments[/h3]
- Since both bosses are airborne enemies, we needed to increase the range of their weapons.
However, we felt that the base stats and weapon upgrades were sufficiently long enough, and we decided to reduce the base range slightly to emphasize the value of the range-enhancing abilities.


[h2]Supply Boxes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reduces HP to break more easily
[/list]
[h3]Developer comments[/h3]
- Supply crates were designed to break on a pistol-based magazine with no magazine size and weapon ability selected,
they were set to use more ammo than that.


[h2]Bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the game would reset when changing settings on first launch and returning to the main menu after gameplay
[*] Fixed a bug where the UI would sometimes not appear in the language you set.
[/list]

notes.title: Emergency Game Improvement Update
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue where players could get stuck in terrain and not be able to move,
Added an "escape" button to return to the beginning of the pause screen.

- Fixed the difficulty level selected on the main screen to persist.
